questions.question:
S can finish 50% of a work in ‘a’ days. T can do 25% of the work in ‘a’ day. Both of them together will finish the work in ____ days.

A. 2.66

B. 2.33

C. 1.33

D. 1.67
questions.solution:
S can finish 50% of the work in = a days

⇒ S can finish 100% work in = 2a days

T can 25% of the work in = a days

⇒ T can 100% work in = 4a days

Suppose, Total work = 4a units (LCM of 2a, 4a)

⇒ Efficiency of S = 4a/2a = 2 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of T = 4a/4a = 1 unit/day

∴ Both S and T together can complete the whole work in = 4a/(2 + 1) = 4a/3 = 1.33a days

questions.question:
Find the fourth proportional to 3.6, 6.9, and 11.4.

A. 20.3

B. 18.9

C. 19.6

D. 21.85
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The numbers are 3.6, 6.9, and 11.4.

**Concept used:**

For finding the fourth proportional of a, b and c.

a/b = c/d

Where d is the fourth proportional.

d = c × b/a

**Calculation:**

Let the fourth proportional to 3.6, 6.9 and 11.4 be x

⇒ 3.6/6.9 = 11.4/x

⇒ x = 11.4 × 6.9/3.6

∴ x = 21.85

**∴ The fourth proportional of the given numbers is 21.85.**

questions.question:
If the length (L cm) and breadth (B cm) of a rectangle are increased by 25%. find the difference between the areas of the old and new rectangles.

A. 3LB/2 sq.cm

B. 24LB/9 sq.cm

C. 9LB/16 sq.cm

D. 16LB/9 sq.cm
questions.solution:
As we know,

Area of the rectangle = Length × Breadth = L × B

⇒ New length of the rectangle = L × 125/100 = 5L/4

⇒ New breadth of the rectangle = B × 125/100 = 5B/4

New area of the rectangle = 5L/4 × 5B/4 = 25LB/16

∴ Difference between area new to old one = 25LB/16 - LB = (25LB – 16LB)/16LB

= 9LB/16 sq.cm.

questions.question:
The average ages of parents and two children are 30 years and 8 years respectively. The average age of the family is

A. 16 years

B. 19 years

C. 18 years

D. 17 years
questions.solution:
The average age of parents and two children are 30 years and 8 years respectively

⇒ Sum of age of parents = 2 × 30 = 60 years

⇒ Sum of the age of two children = 2 × 8 = 16 years

Sum of age of 4 members in the family = 60 + 16 = 76 years

∴ Average age of whole family = 76/4 = 19 years

**Conclusions:**

questions.solution:

Neil Armstrong only echoed the feeling of achievement by mankind. Clearly it is stated in the statement. So, conclusion II follows.

Hence, only conclusion II follows.

questions.question:
A man deposits Rs. 500 at the beginning of each year for 2 years at 10% p.a compound annually. Find the maturity value at the end of the 2ⁿd year.

A. Rs. 1,050

B. Rs. 1,150

C. Rs. 1,155

D. Rs. 1,200
questions.solution:
Deposit amount = Rs. 500, r = 10% and time = 2 years

As we know,

A = P (1 + r/100)ⁿ [A = amount, P = principal, r = rate of interest, n = time]

⇒ A = 500 × (1 + 10/100)² + 500 (1 + 10/100)

⇒ A = 500 × (11/10)² + 500 × (11/10)

⇒ A = 500 × 121/100 + 500 × 11/10

⇒ A = 605 + 550

∴ A = Rs. 1155

questions.question:
If the arithmetic mean of 10 numbers is 35 and each number is increased by 2, find the mean of the new set of numbers.

A. 28

B. 34

C. 40

D. 37
questions.solution:
Arithmetic mean of 10 numbers = 35

⇒ Sum of 10 numbers = 35 × 10 = 350

If each number increased by 2,

⇒ New sum of 10 numbers = 350 + 10 × 2 = 370

∴ New arithmetic mean of 10 numbers = 370/10 = 37

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

When each number is increased by n, then the arithmetic mean also increases by n.

∴ Each number increased by 2, New arithmetic will be = 35 + 2 = 37

A. Barter system

B. Local transport system

C. Buildings made of brick

D. Administrative system
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option (3)**__ i.e **__C__** -

__
 
• The most significant feature of Indus Valley civilization was **the buildings made of the bricks.__**
 
• Indus Valley Civilization is also known as **Harappan Civilization**, which flourished around 2500 BC in **Pakistan and Western India**.
 
• Some of the important Harappan sites are** - Harappa (Pakistan), Mohenjodaro (Pakistan), Sutkagendor (Pakistan), Chanhudaro (Pakistan), Kalibangan (Rajasthan), Lothal and Surkotada (Gujarat), Banawali (Haryana), Dholavira (Gujarat), etc**
 
• In **1924, John Marshall**, **Director-General of Archaeological Society of India (ASI)**, announced the discovery of a new civilization in the Indus Valley to the World.
 
• Indus Valley Civilization was the** largest **of the ancient urban civilization of **Egypt, Mesopotamia, India, and China.**
 
• **ASI** was founded by **Alexander Cunningham** in the year **1861**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• The Indus Valley Civilization was spread from present-day North-East Afghanistan to Pakistan and North-West India. This civilization flourished in the river basins of the Ghaggar-Hakra river and the Indus. Indus valley civilization is one of the four oldest civilizations in the world. It is also known as Harappan Civilization and is well-known for its organized planning based on the grid system. Important facts to be remembered 
 
• John Marshall was the first researcher to use the term, ‘Indus Valley Civilization’.
 
• Indus Valley Civilization spread from the year 2500 – 1750 BC according to radio-carbon dating.
 
• The most distinctive feature of the Harappan Civilization was its urbanization.
 
• Moreover, sheep and goats, dogs, humped cattle buffalo, and elephants were domesticated in the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
• The capital cities are Mohenjodaro and Harappa.
 
• The port cities are Sutkagendor, Balakot, Lothal, Allahdino, and Kuntasi.
 
• The Indus valley people were well-acquainted with the use of both cotton and wool.
 
• Name of the major cities are given below:
 
 
• Mohenjodaro (Sind)-It is located on the right bank of the Indus.

l – b = 6 m ----(i)

As we know,

Perimeter of the rectangle = 2 (l + b)

2 (l + b) = 64

⇒ l + b = 32 ----(ii)

Add equation (i) and equation (ii), we get

2l = 38

⇒ l = 19 m

From equation (ii), we get

⇒ b = 32 – 19

questions.solution:

The side opposite to the greatest angle is always the longest side.

The exterior angle of any triangle is always equal to the sum of opposite interior angles.

The sum of 2 sides of all triangles is always greater than the third side.

The square of one side of a triangle is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides is true only for a right-angled triangle. Hence, this statement is not true for all triangles.

Hence, Statement D is an odd statement.

questions.question:
Usually, color blindness is

A. A genetic disposition

B. A non-genetic condition

C. A lifestyle disease

D. Caused by exposure to light
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is **Option (3)** i.e **A** -

__
 
• Usually, **color blindness** is a **genetic disposition__**. This usually happens between greens and reds, and occasionally blues.
 
• Colour blindness is a genetic condition caused by a **difference in how one or more light-sensitive cells** found in the retina of the eye **respond to certain colors.**
 
• The light-sensitive cells are called **cones**. They sense the wavelengths of the light and enable the retina to distinguish between colors.
 
• The three types of color blindness are - **Red-Green Color Blindness, Blue-Yellow Color Blindness, and Total Color Blindness.**
 
• **Red-Green color blindness** is the most common form.

questions.question:
What will happen to a person's weight when he is in a moving elevator at a constant speed?

A. Increase

B. Decrease

C. Weight will not change

D. May increase or decrease
questions.solution:
__Concept:__

Apparent weight of a person inside a lift

(i) When the lift moves upward with acceleration *a*. Then the net upward force on the person is-

R - mg = ma

∴ Apparent weight, R = mg + ma = m (g + a)

So, when a lift accelerates upwards, the apparent weight of the person inside it increases.

(ii) When the lift moves downwards with acceleration *a*. Then the net downward force on the person is-

Mg - R = ma

∴ Apparent weight, R = mg - ma = m (g - a)

So, when a lift accelerates downwards, the apparent weight of the person inside it decreases.

(iii) When the lift is at rest or moving with uniform velocity v downward/upward. The acceleration *a* = 0, then the net force on the person is-

R - mg = m x 0 = 0

R = mg

∴ Apparent weight = Actual weight

(iv) When the lift falls freely. If the supporting cable of the lift breaks, the lift falls freely under gravity. Then *a = g*. The net downward force on the person is -

R = m(g - g) = 0.

Thus, the apparent weight of the man becomes zero. This is because both the man and the lift are moving downwards with same acceleration *‘g’* and so there are no forces of action and reaction between the person and the lift. Hence a person develops a feeling of weightlessness when he falls freely under gravity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1eb6260b1078371d1cd1b7252a716640ed1835ae02e7796d2a67f39c5c02539.png] 

__Explanation:__

__
 
• From the above explanation and given condition when person in an elevator is moving at constant speed in such case the net acceleration will be zero
 
• Thus we can say that person's weight when he is in a moving elevator **will not change__** because the **apparent weight of the person will be equal to its true weight.**
 
• If the elevator is going up with acceleration, the **apparent weight **of the person is **more** than the **true weight.**
 
• If the elevator is going down with acceleration, the **apparent weight **of the person is **less** than the **true weight.**
 
• If the cord of the lift is broken, it falls freely. In this situation, the **weight of the person** in the elevator becomes **zero.**
 
• While going down, if the acceleration of the elevator is more than the acceleration due to gravity, **a body in the elevator goes in contact with the ceiling of the elevator.**
 
• The Correct Answer is Option (4) i.e., **Weight will not change**

questions.question:
At what percentage simple interest per annum a certain sum will double in 10 years?

A. 7%

B. 8%

C. 9%

D. 10%
questions.solution:
Time = 10 years

Let the sum be Rs. X and rate of interest be r%

⇒ Amount = 2x

⇒ SI = 2x – x = x

As we know,

SI = (P × r × t/100)

⇒ x = (x × r × 10)/100

⇒ r = 100/10

∴ r = 10%
